summary: American Clean Resources Group filed an 8-K disclosing receipt of a non-binding Letter of Intent from Elko Heat Company for up to $40M in joint development capital to support a Bureau of Land Management solar lease acquisition and development at its Millers Property. The LOI is not a binding commitment; funding is subject to due diligence, committee approval, lease issuance, and definitive documentation. No price per share, premium, or board recommendation is stated. The filing reports an exploratory financing arrangement, not a definitive special-situation event, so it is classified as None.
